messages:
tyler.sales: Heads-up — POC with BetaBank showing gaps: several logs arrive with no trace_id and the UI aggregates look wrong. Customer pasted a snippet.
kim-support: Can you drop the forwarder logs and the sample event?
tyler.sales: sample event + logs below:
```
{"timestamp":"2026-03-20T09:12:05Z","level":"info","msg":"batch=17 uploaded","batch_size":1.4}
2026-03-20T09:12:06Z ERROR upload failed status=403 body=\"AccessDenied\" attempt=0
2026-03-20T09:12:06Z INFO assume-role refresh for role=arn:aws:iam::222222222222:role/BB-Forwarder session=3600
2026-03-20T09:12:07Z INFO retrying upload attempt=1
2026-03-20T09:12:09Z ERROR upload failed status=429 body=\"Rate exceeded\" attempt=1
```
ana.ops: Looks like the forwarder assumed a role and then immediately hit a 403 during a batch. When a batch partially uploads and the ingest returns 429 for the remainder, our joiner drops trace mapping for that batch.
rufus.eng: Short explanation: mid-batch credential rotation + ingest rate limit -> partial metadata persisted, payload bodies retried/failed -> trace_id lost for those records.
kim-support: One-line for customer?
tyler.sales: "This is a permissions/session timing issue: increase the STS sessionDuration for the role and add PutObject on the target prefix; as a short-term workaround enable local buffering in the forwarder so uploads complete atomically."
ana.ops: Config snippet to send them:
```
forwarder:
  buffer_mode: local
  s3_prefix: "betabank/poc/%{env}/"
  aws_sts_session_duration: 28800
  retry:
    max_attempts: 5
```
rufus.eng: If they can't touch STS we can route uploads through our upload-proxy (requires ent signoff) or enable multipart commit semantics in the forwarder (we have a feature-flag).
kim-support: Customer also asked about the 429s 12 are those from our side?
quota-bot: [quota] Temporary burst increase granted org=betabank-77 ttl=3h by rufus.eng :white_check_mark:
ana.ops: 429s are the trial-plan ingest throttle. I requested the org id so we could grant a burst; quota-bot just applied it.
tyler.sales: BetaBank applied the config change and retried. They say the dashboard now shows trace ids for the last 2 runs.
rufus.eng: Follow-ups: 1) ops to scan for duplicates from local buffering 2) eng to instrument clearer error when we detect mid-batch STS refresh 3) sales to add short KB note for future POCs.
ana.ops: I'll run the duplicate scan and post results here in ~20m.
deploy-bot: [deploy] forwarder v1.13.0 -> canary started 2026-03-20T09:20:00Z :rocket:
kim-support: Thanks team 12 I'll close the loop with BetaBank and attach the config snippet + a one-liner for their SREs. :thumbsup:
tyler.sales: Great work, folks."
